about: ODIs missing from Cricsheet (abandoned without a ball, or no ball-by-ball file), added by tools/extra_odis.py. Each entry names its source. xi 'series' = each side's most-used XI in the series (abandoned matches: the teams named are not known); xi 'from:<cid>' = the XIs of that match (a stand-in when the real XIs could not be fetched). Bowling plans = the bowlers' average overs in the series.
